editorial.blurb: A welcoming Mexican spot where margaritas flow generously, fresh enchiladas and guacamole hit the mark, and the staff genuinely seems to care about your evening.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a pitcher of margaritas—reviewers note they're generous enough for 4-5 people and better value than individual drinks. Come on a Saturday night; despite busy crowds, the team seats walk-ins promptly and delivers water, chips, and salsa immediately.
